items.followUp: Differentiate between homologous chromosomes and sister chromatids.

rubric.why: Identifies sister chromatids as copies of the same chromosome joined at the centromere.
rubric.description: Sister chromatids are identical copies of one chromosome joined at the centromere.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying them as identical copies of the same chromosome and stating that they are joined at the centromere.

rubric.why: Identifies non-sister chromatids as chromatids belonging to homologous chromosomes.
rubric.description: Non-sister chromatids belong to the two homologous chromosomes; they are not identical copies and may exchange segments during crossing over.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that non-sister chromatids belong to a pair of homologous chromosomes.

modelAnswer: Sister chromatids are identical copies of one chromosome joined together at the centromere.
Non-sister chromatids belong to the two homologous chromosomes, one inherited from each parent; they are not identical copies and may exchange segments during crossing over.
